limitations: Original visual plane-gap interpretation, not clinical philtrum anatomy, isolated segmentation, AI/3D or proprietary equivalence.
Full24 measured nose connection geometry and all40 lip/lower source targets are audited; no complete anatomical nose pixel visibility claim.
Actual nose2-to-lip0 change is additive .08*amount*H, where H is margin-trimmed plane gap; not generally8percent of actual anatomical interval.
Shared P=D/H<=8 may refuse short real gaps. Refusal prevalence is unmeasured; no inflated H, dropped vertices, moved lip plane, shortened plateau or silently reduced strength.
Full-width band moves cheek tissue; lower plateau and feather move lowerface/neck/background. Source invariants do not hold for arbitrary points relocated by prior operations.
Complete influence rectangle and small moving-strip sample gates remain conservative; difficult, occluded or neighboring faces can refuse.
Inherited bounded f64 inverse can refuse underflow/stagnation; tiny accepted shifts can vanish in subtraction or downstream float32 coordinates.
Existing chin-length/legacy compatibility and malformed multi-enabled-conflict graph recovery limit remain unchanged. No prior effect is silently reset or migrated.
Generic derived presets remain guarded; explicitly reviewed target-person transfer rebuilds each target actual source/support.
Broader alpha/HDR, remaining handbook features and real photographic/workflow acceptance remain unfinished.
